class: A marker a process leaves for the dashboard outlives the process
symptom: Aristocrat (Workday): the run stopped for three required questions, was then stopped from the dashboard, and the dashboard went on showing it as 'Paused in the browser' with a Continue button. Pressing Reload code wrote a signal no process would ever read, so the application looked stalled.
root_cause: A waiting run writes data/_waiting_<run>.txt and removes it when its wait ends; a killed run cannot remove it. The Stop cleanup cleared only the older _signal_ files, and the dashboard listed every _waiting_ note without asking whether any run was alive to read an answer.
why_tests_missed: The Continue-button tests covered a run that waits and a run that is answered, never a run that dies while waiting.
fix: web_ui.clear_waiting_files() removes both kinds of leftover; Stop and the process sweep call it, and the Applications page lists waiting runs only while a run is live, clearing the notes otherwise. The run card and the application page also link the run's log.
prevention: Anything a process leaves on disk to say 'I am here' is checked against the process being alive before it is shown, and every way a process can end (finish, stop, crash) clears it.
